evals.name: cf-space-role-barriers-are-per-space
evals.description: Multiple role assignments gate only the CF resources in their own created space.

files.content:
# Landscape

- Subaccount: dev-sa
  - Cloud Foundry environment: dev-org
    - Spaces: dev-apps, dev-data

# Services

- name: orders
  consumption_type: instance
  location: cf
  cf_space: dev-apps
- name: reporting
  consumption_type: instance
  location: cf
  cf_space: dev-data

# Trust

### CF space user assignments
- space_name: dev-apps
  username: alice@example.com
  role: space_developer
  origin: sap.ids
- space_name: dev-apps
  username: bob@example.com
  role: space_manager
  origin: sap.ids
- space_name: dev-data
  username: carol@example.com
  role: space_developer
  origin: sap.ids

assertions.text: Creates one cloudfoundry_space_role task for each trust assignment, each after its matching space
Makes the orders task depend on dev-apps and both dev-apps role tasks
Makes the reporting task depend on dev-data and only the dev-data role task, without cross-space role dependencies

evals.name: missing-cf-space-roles-stop-task-generation
evals.description: A created space with a scoped CF resource cannot produce an unsafe task list without roles.

files.content:
# Landscape

- Subaccount: dev-sa
  - Cloud Foundry environment: dev-org
    - Spaces: dev-apps

# Services

- name: orders
  consumption_type: instance
  location: cf
  cf_space: dev-apps

assertions.text: Stops before writing specs/tasks.md because dev-apps has a CF-scoped resource but no CF space role assignment
Directs the user to rerun /sap-iac.security and record the required dev-apps role assignments

evals.name: custom-idp-trust-configuration-omits-derived-origin
evals.description: Tasks map the IdP URL without treating its derived origin as explicit input.

files.content:
# Trust

## dev-sa

### Custom IdP
- IdP URL: https://corp.accounts.ondemand.com
- Origin: corp-platform

assertions.text: Creates a btp_subaccount_trust_configuration task with identity_provider set to https://corp.accounts.ondemand.com
The trust-configuration task omits origin and origin_explicit despite the derived Origin field

evals.name: custom-idp-trust-configuration-carries-explicit-origin
evals.description: Only the dedicated security-stage field enables trust-configuration origin metadata.

files.content:
# Trust

## dev-sa

### Custom IdP
- IdP URL: https://corp.accounts.ondemand.com
- Origin: corp-platform
- Trust configuration origin: corp-custom
- Trust configuration origin explicit: true

assertions.text: The btp_subaccount_trust_configuration task contains identity_provider, origin = corp-custom, and origin_explicit = true
